schemaEvidence.authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 20.4.101.4, page 245
schemaEvidence.finding: BS 171 states whether margin overrides are present. The six BD 40 values are conditional on that flag; with flag zero, their absence is part of the record layout.

implementation.summary: The R24 nested DXF parser now accepts group 94 immediately after group 171 only when margin override flags are zero; explicit-marker ordering and border-count bounds remain enforced. The DWG-to-DXF writer admits the witnessed all-explicit or all-inherited custom-cell margin profile, omits MARGIN/CELLMARGIN and six group-40 values for flag-zero cells, and still rejects mixed or other values. The default Table style remains in its witnessed explicit-margin profile.
implementation.failureBehavior: Generated ASCII and Binary controls reject mixed margin profiles and preserve the existing destination, then restore the witnessed profile and succeed on the same adapter. Existing invalid-prefix and unresolved-text-style rollback controls remain active.
implementation.semanticScope: Field-presence and serializer/readback behavior only; margin inheritance/rendered appearance is not independently established.

peerObservation.observation: The TABLESTYLE _TITLE record has group 171=0 and proceeds directly to group 94, with no MARGIN/CELLMARGIN markers or six margin group-40 values.
peerObservation.limitation: This peer output omits the source _HEADER and _DATA records. It corroborates conditional absence for one emitted cell style only; it is incomplete and is not used as full TABLESTYLE support or semantic evidence.
